what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Kiribati, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2015, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 2520 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Kiribati list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Kiribati.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, starting in 2008.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced above zero.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Kiribati.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
